facts.text: John reached the summit of a mountain during a mountaineering trip with workmates.

evidence.quote: I went on a mountaineering trip last week with some workmates. It was great and helped clear my head.
Thanks, Maria! Yeah, we made it to the top and the view was stunning.

facts.text: Maria described a hiking experience as breath-taking and awe-inspiring.

evidence.quote: Hiking to the top and seeing this was awesome! Breath-taking.
I felt like I was in a fairy tale! The water sounded so calming and the surroundings were beautiful. It was truly magical!

facts.text: Maria shared a family road trip to Oregon with her family when she was younger.

evidence.quote: When I was younger, my family and I went on a road trip to Oregon.

facts.text: John expressed admiration for Maria's experience at a waterfall with a bridge over it.

evidence.quote: Wow, Maria! That waterfall and bridge look amazing! What a view.
Hiking to the top and seeing this was awesome! Breath-taking.
